channelTypeArchive: Move message to an IMAP folder
channelTypeFlag: Mark read, star or label (no move)
forwardModeAttachmentDescription: A short note from Eumaeus with the original attached as a .eml file. Nothing about the original is lost.
forwardModeInlineDescription: The original quoted in the body, like your mail app's Forward button. Easiest to read.
forwardModeRedirectDescription: The original message itself, sent on unchanged with its original sender.
digestCantRedirect: A digest can't be a redirect — it's a summary of several emails.
redirectWarning: Redirected mail keeps the original sender, but it leaves from your SMTP server. Many receiving servers treat that as spoofing (SPF/DMARC) and send it to spam or reject it. Use it only for recipients whose server you control.
digestHint: Emails wait here and go out together as one message.
digestHintAttachment: Each original is attached as a .eml file.
digestHintExcerpt: Each email appears as a short excerpt.
senderNamePlaceholder: Defaults to the SMTP sender name
senderAddressHint: The address is always your SMTP sender address.
includeAnalysis: Add Jev's analysis (spam score, category, urgency) to the message
forwardFooter: Every new address is sent a confirmation email, and nothing is forwarded to it until its owner confirms. To also take the original out of the inbox, add a "Move message to an IMAP folder" channel to this same destination.
autoReplyBodyPlaceholder:
Hello {sender_name},

Thanks for your message. We'll get back to you within two working days.
autoReplyBodyHint: Plain text. You can use {sender_name}, {sender}, {subject} and {category}.
cooldownLabel: At most one reply per sender every
maxSpamScoreLabel: Skip if spam score is at least
autoReplyFooter: Never answers automated mail (newsletters, mailing lists, auto-responders, no-reply addresses), likely spam, or mail that arrived before auto-replies were available. Replies count toward the organization's daily outgoing-mail limit (Organization › Forwarding).
ticketSecretHint: After saving, add the API token under this destination's Secrets with exactly this name. It's stored encrypted and never shown again.
jiraTokenHint: Create it at id.atlassian.com › Security › API tokens.
zendeskTokenHint: Create it in Zendesk Admin Center › Apps and integrations › Zendesk API.
labelsHint: Comma-separated, one word each (no spaces). On Gmail these become labels; on other servers they're IMAP keywords your mail app may show as tags.
archiveFolderHint: Moves the message into this folder on the mailbox it came from, e.g. "Junk" or "Trash" to get spam out of the inbox without deleting it. A move can be undone from the email's page.
incomingWebhookUrlEditing: Incoming webhook URL (re-enter the full URL)
slackWebhookHint: Slack › Apps › Incoming Webhooks › Add to a channel. The URL works like a password; only its host is shown after saving.
teamsWebhookHint: In the Teams channel: Workflows › “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”. The URL works like a password; only its host is shown after saving.
flagFooter: The message stays where it is. To also move it, use a "Move message to an IMAP folder" channel instead. It can set these same flags before moving.
title: Destinations
subtitle: Where routed emails are sent.
emptyDescription: Create a destination so rules have somewhere to route matched emails.
deleteSecretDescription: Any webhook using "{name}" will stop signing requests with it. This cannot be undone.
autoReplyLimits: one reply per sender every {days} day(s) · not when spam score ≥ {score}
noLiveChannelsDescription: A rule routed here won't actually do anything until this destination has at least one enabled channel.
disableAllDescription: Routing rules pointing here will escalate to Human Review instead of delivering. This does not delete the destination or its history.
disableChannelDescription: Mail routed to this destination will stop going through this channel. Other channels keep working; past executions keep their history.
nothingForwarded: Nothing is forwarded to this address
forwardRecipientsDescription: Addresses your forward channels send to. Each one has to confirm by email before anything is forwarded to it.
smtpNotConfigured: SMTP isn't configured, so no email could be sent. Set it up in Settings.
stopForwardingDescription: Nothing more will be forwarded to {address}. Channels that list it keep sending to their other recipients. You can ask the address to confirm again later.
notifyGroupHint: Follows the team: people who gain or lose the permission are included or dropped automatically.
notifyMembersNone: No active members in this organization.
notifyAddressesHint: Each address gets a confirmation email first and is notified only after confirming. Mailboxes Eumaeus watches are never notified.
notifyPlaceholdersHint: Placeholders: {subject} {sender} {sender_name} {mailbox} {category} {urgency} {spam} {destination}. The notice always shows the sender, mailbox, time, Jev's view and a button to the email.
notifyIncludeExcerpt: Include the first 500 characters of the email
notifyDeliveryHint_each: One notice per email, right away.
notifyDeliveryHint_throttle: The first email is announced right away; the ones that follow within the window come together in the next notice.
notifyDeliveryHint_digest: Emails are collected and sent as one list.
notifyPreviewFailed: The preview could not be built.
